## Checklist
- [ ] No personal data: no real floor plans, photos, addresses, site links, PINs or keys
- [ ] Node-only tooling (no bash/PowerShell-only scripts), works on Windows, macOS and Linux
- [ ] User-facing text in English **and** Indonesian
- [ ] Engine stays data-driven (no house-specific code in `engine/`)
- [ ] New assets are CC0 or my own work, with credits
- [ ] Wizard changes (`CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/`) are mirrored in `docs/WIZARD.md` and `docs/WIZARD.id.md`
